scope: Metadata-only exact design and estimability audit. No phenotype values, source count rows or outcome missingness are read.
selected_units: All 66 previously fixed local states, 30 intended-variant groups, five exons, two cell contexts.
alignment: Parse the two source-design substitution brackets, authenticate their genomic coordinate spacing and reference/alternative bases, then require a unique exact counted DNA word in the alternative designed context. Record every observed coordinate and mark all positions outside that word as unknown.
descriptor_model: Separate exon intercepts plus one indicator per recorded physical nonreference allele. Zero means absence from the recorded pair descriptor, not a verified wild-type base outside the counted window.
interactions: Products for every distinct observed pair of physical allele indicators. Evaluate span gain and parameter aliases. Do not fit outcomes.
context_models: Strict shared descriptor model; shared descriptor slopes with cell-specific exon offsets; fully context-specific descriptor model; context-specific observed-pair model.
exact_checks: Exact left and right nullspace verification
Column-space invariance under descriptor reference recoding
Common observed-window agreement for each rectangle
interpretation: Standard finite design rank and estimability, not a novel theorem or a full haplotype/protein claim. Any factorial contrast is conditional on the authenticated common local sequence window. No outcome test is authorized by this audit.
